description: Who may do what in the Architecture Decision Studio. This file is a control plane: changing it changes who can approve, so it is changed only by a human in a reviewed pull request, never by a Studio action, an AI agent or a Markdown comment. People are identified by a stable subject (github:<numeric id> or entra:<tenant id>:<object id>), never by a name or an email. Only entries marked kind human are read; a bot, service principal or agent entry is dropped. Approvals are accepted only from the providers listed in authentication.approvalProviders (production: entra). An approval is also recorded in a signed event whose signing key lives with the server, not in this repository. Architecture approval never authorises a regulatory filing or a production deployment; those are separate processes outside the Studio.

enrollment.reference: Owner instruction in chat on 2026-10-30 that this GitHub account be registered as programme owner. Bootstrap: no second person approved it, and a chat instruction is not a signed approval. A GitHub sign-in is accepted for approvals only on a development server (STUDIO_ALLOW_DEV_APPROVALS=1). Replace with an Entra enrollment once a tenant exists.
